scenes.en: This paper introduces the Transformer, a new model for sequence tasks.
scenes.zh: 本文介绍了Transformer，一种用于序列任务的新模型。

scenes.en: Existing models rely on recurrence or convolution, which are hard to parallelize.
scenes.zh: 现有模型依赖循环或卷积，难以并行化。

scenes.en: The Transformer uses self-attention to relate all positions directly.
scenes.zh: Transformer使用自注意力直接关联所有位置。

scenes.en: The architecture stacks self-attention and feed-forward layers in encoder and decoder.
scenes.zh: 该架构在编码器和解码器中堆叠自注意力和前馈层。

scenes.label: English-to-German translation
scenes.en: It achieves 28.4 BLEU on English-to-German, improving over previous best by over 2 BLEU.
scenes.zh: 它在英德翻译上达到28.4 BLEU，比之前最佳高出超过2 BLEU。
scenes.evidence: arXiv:1706.03762 · “Our model achieves 28.4 BLEU on the WMT 2014 English-to-German translation task”

scenes.note: Paper: Attention Is All You Need
scenes.en: The Transformer shows attention alone can outperform recurrent and convolutional models.
scenes.zh: Transformer表明，仅靠注意力就能超越循环和卷积模型。
